goal: Run Bitcoin Core node, wallet, and GUI components in isolated processes
Prevent memory corruption or crashes in the GUI or wallet from compromising or taking down the node
agreement: Broad support for the architectural direction of process separation (jonasschnelli, gmaxwell, dcousens, laanwj)
Concept approval citing ability to run the node continuously while opening the GUI on demand (Sjors)
Concerns over Cap'n Proto dependency were accepted as internal IPC for this change (gmaxwell, dcousens)
Open question on whether capnp should be added to depends in a future PR (Sjors)

categories.name: ipc
why: P1 because process isolation prevents UI and wallet flaws from compromising consensus validation
Unblocks follow-up multiprocess architecture work across the codebase

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because running the wallet as an independent process shields the node from wallet crashes
Provides durable isolation against wallet-level memory corruption vulnerabilities
